# Verify and explain

Choose a sample ID from your metadata (start with S01). Recalculate its taxon total, detected taxa and natural-log Shannon diversity:

```bash
python scripts/python/verify_sample.py data/synthetic results/synthetic S01
```

Compare the manual values with the saved results. Explain Shannon using richness and evenness. Then write one observation per figure, checking values in the tables. State limitations and a useful follow-up check.
